concentration.text: aqueous solution of 20% to 40% water content

procedure_text: 1)将环磺酮产品溶解在含水溶液中，升温；
procedure_summary: The tembotrione product is dissolved in an aqueous solvent mixture and the solution is warmed. Nothing is isolated at this point; the warm solution is carried into the next step.
notes: Step 1) of the method of [0013], narrowed by [0017], [0018] and [0019]. non_synthetic true: no bond is made or broken, the operation is a dissolution and a warming. reaction_class other because the closed list has no value for dissolving a solid in a solvent; confidence high on that reading, not on there being a reaction. The transformation tag category is skipped rather than guessed, since there is no transformation. A purification neither consumes nor creates the substance, so the material entering this step and the material leaving it are the same identifier, tembotrione. TWO-ENTRY FORM, AND WHY IT CHANGED: this record represents that with one entry role reactant and is_product false, plus, where the step actually isolates something, a second entry role product with is_product true. These four records were first written with a single dual-flagged entry instead, role reactant with is_product true, on the reasoning that duplicating an identifier in compounds[] looks like an extraction error and that the reference run has no non_synthetic record to follow. They were changed to the two-entry form for consistency with the other nine section files of this run, which annotate the same situation that way, and not because the single-entry reading was found to be wrong. The consequence that decided it: A3 rule 3 derives the pathway KSM from a step's reactants excluding its products, so a single dual-flagged entry left the reactant set empty and the KSM for this pathway resolved to acetonitrile, which is a solvent. The change was made at the coordinator's instruction; recorded here as an overruled reading rather than withdrawn silently. Purity is what distinguishes crude from purified in this document and this section states none, so every quantity block, purity_pct and product_purity_pct stay null on both entries. NOTHING IS ISOLATED HERE, so no product entry is created and no product is invented: the material stays in solution and is carried into the next operation. missing_product is raised on that fact and is_complete is false, which is what Claims Step 1 and Claims Step 2 do for these same two operations. SOLVENT AMBIGUITY LEFT OPEN: [0017] joins 乙腈, 甲醇, 乙醇 and 二甲基甲酰胺 with the Chinese enumeration comma and does not say whether one of the four or all four mixed with water is meant; the EN convenience line reads them as alternatives with 'or', which the Chinese does not state. All four are listed as solvents on this record and the ambiguity is recorded, not resolved. The water content is printed as the range 20% to 40%, which the single concentration.value float cannot hold, so value is null and the range is carried in concentration.text. Temperature is the range 30 to 60 degrees C from [0019]; 升温 names no heating method, so heating_method is null. No stirring, no reactor, no time and no charge are stated anywhere in the section, hence scale not_specified. safety_notes is empty by decision: the only safety-adjacent statement in the section is the Ames-test objective at [0012], which is the purpose of the method and not a statement about this step. The section is a recitation in words of the same three-step purification claim 1 recites. Duplication is not linkage, so precursor_step is never set to a Claims step; links are only within this section. NO DRAWN SCHEME IN THIS SECTION. Checked for one: lines 107 to 136 carry no [IMAGE_EXTRACT] span of any kind, neither a reactions span nor a molecules span, so the whole route here is prose. Prompt rule 5f asserts that in this document Summary of the Invention ends with a drawn multi-arrow scheme and that the prose and the scheme disagree on two steps; that is a description of the previous patent carried over in the shared prompt body, and no scheme records were manufactured from it. For the same reason prompt rule 1's 'each N, <compound name> marker starts a step' does not apply: this section marks its steps 1), 2), 3) with no compound name attached.
